'''Alyava Thomcro''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a vendor in the [[Republic Command Center (Dantooine)|command center]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Tokare Garrison]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Dantooine Incursion]].<ref name="Alyava Thomcro" />

Thomcro wore a [[Color/Legends|white]] and black [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]] that had silver plating above the shoulders and knees and on the wrists. The outfit had a white hood and black sleeves. She wore silver boots, with two spikes near the front on each one. She [[Language/Legends|spoke]] [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Alyava Thomcro" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Alyava Thomcro first appears<ref name="Alyava Thomcro" /> in Update 5.10.3, released on [[June 4]], [[2019]],<ref name="5.10.3 Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190604|text=Game Update 5.10.3 "The Dantooine Incursion" is Live!}}</ref> for [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Alyava Thomcro" />
